pulses.name: Converging Interests: Analysis of Threat Clusters Targeting a Southeast Asian Government
pulses.description: Unit 42 researchers uncovered a series of cyberespionage campaigns targeting a Southeast Asian government organization between June and August 2025. Three distinct activity clusters were identified: Stately Taurus, CL-STA-1048, and CL-STA-1049. Stately Taurus used USB-propagated malware to deploy the PUBLOAD backdoor. CL-STA-1048 employed an espionage toolkit including EggStremeFuel backdoor, Maso
